ItemID: 1; Title: Fuzion Calibration Weights 7 PCS, 1g 2g 5g 10g 20g Stainless Steel Scale Calibration Weight Kit, Calibration Weight with Storage Box, Tweezers for Digital Scale Gram Scale Balance; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current scale-calibration need; my recent work centers on fastening and fabrication.
ItemID: 2; Title: 304 Stainless Steel E Clip Assortment Kit E-Clip External Retaining Ring Assortment Set (M1.5-M15,425 PCS); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to complement my cotter pins and fastener assortments for mechanical repairs.
ItemID: 3; Title: 335PCS Self Tapping Screws 410 Stainless Steel #8#10 Self Drilling Screws TEK Head Sheet Metal Screws, Wafer Head & Hex Washer for Metal, Wood, Plastic, Car and Furniture; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would use these for sheet-metal fastening alongside my drill bits and rivets, although some overlap my existing screws.
ItemID: 4; Title: AUTOGEN 5 Gallon Vacuum Chamber Kit Tempered Glass Lid with 4 CFM Single Stage Vacuum Pump HVAC; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My earlier resin purchase makes this interesting, but I do not currently have a project requiring vacuum equipment.
ItemID: 5; Title: MAYILON HT208D Digital Clamp Meter AC/DC 1000A 6000 Counts Multimeter Current Voltage Tester with Temperature, NCV, LPF, AC/DC Voltage and Current Test, Frequency, Resistance, Capacitance Etc.; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like diagnostic tools, but my recent purchases do not suggest an immediate electrical-testing task.
ItemID: 6; Title: Rubber Grommets Kit,Hincell 63Pcs Double Sided Round Rubber Grommet Kit for Wiring Drill Hole Firewall Hole Plugs Wire Protection for Automotive Plumbing, 6 Sizes 5/8" 13/16" 7/8" 1" 1-3/16" 1-1/2"; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these to protect wiring through drilled panels; they serve a different purpose from my recent eyelet grommets.
ItemID: 7; Title: 1/16 Wire Rope,100M/328FT 304 Stainless Steel Wire Cable,Vinyl Coated Aircraft Cable,Steel Cable with Loops,M5 Turnbuckles for Cables Wire,Hanging Wire,Tension Wire; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific hanging or tensioning project that calls for this much cable right now.

ItemID: 9; Title: Wire Wheel Cup Brush Set,Coarse Crimped Carbon Steel,1/4In Hex Shank for Drill,Die Grinder Wire Brush for Cleaning Rust (24); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for rust removal and surface preparation to complement my metal drilling and cutting supplies.
